title: 48 Korean Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Korean for Beginners (Meeting People & Greetings)
description:
Learn 48 essential Korean phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Korean #LearnKorean #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 한국어, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Korean with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 48 real-life phrases
- 한국어 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

MEETING PEOPLE & GREETINGS · 사람 만나기 및 인사
• Hello, I’m glad you’re here - 안녕하세요, 와 주셔서 반가워요  [ANnyeonghaseyo, WA jusyeoseo BANgaWEOyo]
• Nice to meet you in person - 직접 뵈어서 반가워요  [JIKjeop BWEoseo BANgaWEOyo]
• What do you do for work? - 직업이 어떻게 돼요?  [JIK-eob-i Eotteohke DWEyo?]
• Have we met before, maybe? - 전에 뵌 적 있어요, 혹시?  [JONje BWEN jeok I-sseo-yo, hokshi?]
• I’ll share, what brings you today? - 오늘 뭐 하러 오셨어요?  [ONEUL Mwo haREO O-syeoSSEOyo?]
• How’s your day going so far? - 오늘은 하루가 어떻게 가고 있어요?  [ONEUL-eun HARUga Eotteohge GAgo isseo-yo?]

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · 감정 및 느낌
• I feel calm, finally breathing again - 마침내 숨 좀 돌릴 수 있어서 마음이 차분해요  [MACHIMNAE SUM JOM DOLRIL SU ISSSEO MAEUMI CHACHUNHAEYO]
• My chest is tight with worry - 걱정 때문에 가슴이 답답해요  [GEOKJEONG TTAEMUNAE GASEUMI DABDAPHAEYO]
• I’m uneasy about that text - 그 문자 내용이 불안해서 찝찝해요  [GEU MUNJA NAEYONGI BULANHAESEO JIPJIPHAEYO]
• I feel proud of myself today - 오늘은 내가 해냈다는 게 자랑스러워요  [ONEUL-EUN NAEGA HENNAETTANEUN GE JARANGSEUREOWOYO]
• I’m actually happy you called - 전화해 줘서 정말 고마워요, 마음이 편해요  [JEONHWAHAE JWOSSEO JEONGMAL GOMAWOYO, MAEUMI PYEONAHAEYO]
• I feel jealous, but I’ll be okay - 조금 질투 나지만, 괜찮아질 거예요  [JOGEUM JILTUNAJIMAN, GWAENCHANAJIL GEOYEYO]

WEATHER & SMALL TALK · 날씨 및 가벼운 대화
• Looks like rain, doesn't it? - 비 오려나 봐, 그렇지?  [Bi o-ryeona bwa, geureochi?]
• Is it windy where you are? - 너는 지금 바람 많이 불어?  [Neoneun jigeum baram mani bureo?]
• Man, it's muggy right now. - 진짜 너무 후텁지근하네.  [Jin-jja neomu huteop-jigeun-hane.]
• Do you feel that cold front? - 찬바람 들어오는 거 느껴져?  [Chanbaram deureo-oneun geo neuk-kyeo-jyeo?]
• I might need sunscreen later. - 나중에 선크림 발라야겠어.  [Najung-e seon-keu-rim bal-la-ya-get-sseo.]
• That cloud cover is thick. - 구름이 완전 잔뜩 껴있네.  [Gureumi waanjeon jant-tteok kkeo-it-ne.]

KINDNESS · 친절
• Can I take some of that burden? - 그거, 제가 조금 도와드려도 될까요?  [Geugeo, jega jogeum dowa dwoedo doilkkayo?]
• You didn’t have to explain everything. - 다 설명해 주지 않아도 괜찮아요.  [Da seolmyeonghae juji anhaedo gwaenchanayo.]
• I’m listening, take your time. - 들어줄게요, 천천히 말해요.  [Deureojulgeyo, cheoncheonhi malhaeyo.]
• That was thoughtful of you, seriously. - 진짜 배려해 줘서 고마워요.  [Jinjjja baeryeohae jwoseo gomawoyo.]
• Want a hand with that task? - 그 일, 제가 도와드릴까요?  [Geu il, jega dowa deulikkayo?]
• I’ll check in later, no rush. - 나중에 다시 연락드릴게요, 급하지 않으셔도 돼요.  [Najunge dashi yeonrakteureilgeyo, geupaji aneusyeodo dwaeyo.]

TRAVEL & AIRPORT · 여행 및 공항
• Where’s the immigration line, please? - 출입국 심사 줄이 어디예요, 어디죠?  [CHUL IP GUK SIM SA JURI EODIEYO, EODU JYO]
• Could you help me with this form? - 이 양식 작성하는 거 도와주실 수 있어요?  [I YANG SIK JAK SEONGHANEUN GEO DO WAH JU SHIL SU ISSSEOYO]
• I can’t find my gate, sorry. - 미안한데, 제 게이트를 못 찾겠어요.  [MIAN HANDE, JE GEITEU-REUL MOT CHATGESSSEOYO]
• Is there a charger I can borrow? - 충전기 좀 빌릴 수 있어요?  [CHUNG JEON GI JOM BIL RIL SU ISSSEOYO]
• Can I use a restroom nearby? - 근처에 화장실 있어요?  [GEUN CHO E HWA JANG SHIL ISSSEOYO]
• Do you have a lost and found desk? - 분실물 찾는 곳이 있어요?  [BUN SIL MUL CHATNEUN GOT-I ISSSEOYO]

MINDFULNESS · 마음챙김
• Right now, soften your shoulders. - 지금 어깨 힘을 빼요.  [jigeum EO-kke himeul ppae-yo.]
• Let sounds be just sounds. - 소리는 소리로만 두세요.  [so-ri-neun so-ri-ro-man du-se-yo.]
• Unfreeze your hands, slowly. - 손을 천천히 풀어봐요.  [so-neul cheon-cheon-hi pul-eo-bwa-yo.]
• Notice tension, then choose ease. - 긴장을 알아차리고, 편안함을 선택해요.  [jin-jang-eul a-ra-cha-ri-go, pyeo-an-ham-eul seon-taek-hae-yo.]
• Feel your back against the chair. - 의자에 등을 기대 보세요.  [ui-ja-e deung-eul gi-dae bo-se-yo.]
• Check in with your body, quietly. - 몸 상태를 조용히 확인해요.  [mom saeng-tae-reul jo-yong-hi hwak-in-hae-yo.]

FORGIVENESS · 용서
• Thank you for saying sorry, seriously. - 진심으로 사과해줘서 고마워요.  [JINSIMEURO SAGAHAEJWOSEO GOMAWEOYO.]
• I can move forward without revenge. - 보복 없이도 우린 앞으로 갈 수 있어요.  [BOK-BOK EOPSHI-DO URIN APEURO GAL SU ISSEOYO.]
• I forgive you, but I need time. - 용서할게요, 근데 시간이 좀 필요해요.  [YONGSEOHALGEOYO, KEUNDE SHIGANI JOM PIRYOHAEYO.]
• Let's talk honestly, starting with what happened. - 무슨 일이 있었는지부터 솔직히 이야기해요.  [MUSEUN IL-I ITESNEUNJI-BUTEU SOLJIKHI IYAGIHAEYO.]
